prose: TLDR AI points to social posts showing an apparent next Anthropic model, 'Claude Next', being tested under Opus 5.5 in Claude Code. One user says it built a 3D model from a one-sentence prompt over two hours with Blender MCP; another claims it makes image and video generation look obsolete. A third tester doubts the difference, saying Opus 5.5 seems to route to a newer model but results aren't dramatically better. All are anecdotal posts, not an Anthropic announcement.
highlights: Posts claim an unreleased Anthropic model is being tested in Claude Code.
One demo: a Blender scene from a one-sentence prompt after two hours.
Another tester sees only modest differences; Opus 5.5 may route to a newer model.
Evidence is anecdotal and unconfirmed by Anthropic.
